questions.question: Paul thanked God for what He put into Titus's heart for the Christians in Corinth. What was it?

answers.text: The same devotion Paul had for them
A wish to lead their church himself
A worry about how they had been giving

questions.question: When Paul's team handled a generous gift from the churches, what did Paul want to avoid?

answers.text: Any criticism of how it was handled
Any delay in getting it delivered
Any churches finding out about it

questions.question: Paul knew the Christians in Corinth were eager to give. Why did he still send brothers to visit them?

answers.text: So his boasting would not prove empty
So he could ask for a bigger gift
So they could check on the teaching

questions.question: Paul urged brothers to visit Corinth first and arrange the gift the people had promised. How did he want it prepared?

answers.text: Quietly and not in public view
